BiblicalUsage: Mallothi was a son of Heman, one of the singers set apart for the service of song in 1 Chronicles 25:4, and 1 Chronicles 25:26 says the nineteenth course fell to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, twelve in all. He was one of the fourteen sons of Heman set apart for the song of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God orders worship down to the rota: every singer had his course, and Mallothi's was the nineteenth.
